mechanism.takes: a folder of agent configuration files (markdown with YAML frontmatter, JSON settings) on the local machine, plus every project folder the agent tool has been used in
mechanism.does: indexes them by kind and scope, renders them in an editor-side panel with a form for the frontmatter and a text editor for the body, and writes edits back preserving untouched formatting and line endings
mechanism.returns: the same files edited in place, created, renamed, duplicated or moved to the trash

portsAsIs: frontmatter form editor that keeps unchanged keys byte-identical
editor-panel layout with searchable sidebar and per-scope sections
isolated-instance verification over the debugging protocol
perCustomer: the set of configuration kinds and their folder layout
where the list of project folders comes from
evidence: verified in an isolated VS Code instance opened on a repo with a local harness: 27 repositories listed, local agent opened and edited
